Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 65 km this is Jura Crest Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-dorfstation-littoral-de-chens-sur.story: A 290 km round trip from Erlach - roughly 5 h in the saddle. On the way it passes Baie de Clendy, Littoral de Chens-sur-Léman and back through Baie de Clendy. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from Switzerland into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
